english.title: Fail to provide name / address or give false name / address when required to do so
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the occupier of a domestic property, namely **(..SPECIFY PROPERTY..),

(A)_[failed to give your]_
(B)_[gave a false or inaccurate]_

name or address, when required to do so under section 34ZA(13) of the Environmental Protection Act 1990, by **(..SPECIFY NAME..), an authorised officer proposing to give you a fixed penalty notice
english.legislation: Contrary to section 34ZA(14) and (15) of the Environmental Protection Act 1990.
